lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy8Ag4Te4 (reduced formula Dy2AgTe) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag centers with a tetrahedral environment of four Te neighbors, Dy centers with eight geometric neighbors (four Ag and four Te), and Te centers with nine neighbors (six Dy and three Ag). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Ag tetrahedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Dy and Te polyhedra.
